summary.going_well: The agent consistently reached the requested soft-credit-review versus summary choice, including for the <ref job="SRJ_rQaQ7dAu4Z8a" item="item_3fab2077-fda">cash-out refinance</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_KmBFYz9ZWeUM" item="item_ee167678-7b7">HELOC</ref> borrowers. It explained that a HELOC's <ref job="SRJ_KmBFYz9ZWeUM" item="item_3da87ee1-1d0">rate is typically variable and payments may rise after the draw period</ref> without quoting a rate or payment.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize removing overbroad conventional-loan claims, then ensure each required discovery question receives an explicit answer before advancing. Handle declined employer names as declined rather than silently complete, and keep acknowledgments neutral instead of assessing borrowers or products.

issues.description: In both refinance conversations, the agent volunteered categorical conventional-loan advantages, including <ref job="SRJ_rQaQ7dAu4Z8a" item="item_5abc76d1-1d2">“no permanent mortgage insurance once you reach 20% equity”</ref>; the <ref job="SRJ_gRhx42GaQjwb" item="item_5ae1fdb3-834">same pitch</ref> was given to a borrower seeking a lower payment. This can mislead borrowers about when mortgage insurance ends and about available loan terms.
issues.suggestion: Remove unsolicited conventional-loan sales copy from discovery; when comparison is requested, qualify insurance and fee rules by loan terms and defer institution-specific details to a licensed loan officer.
issues.label: Product guidance

issues.description: Discovery advanced despite missing responses: the HELOC agent asked whether the <ref job="SRJ_KmBFYz9ZWeUM" item="item_3da87ee1-1d0">variable-rate structure made sense</ref>, then <ref job="SRJ_KmBFYz9ZWeUM" item="item_6fcb82db-51e">moved to home value</ref> without asking the required rate-comfort question. In the refinance flow, it also <ref job="SRJ_gRhx42GaQjwb" item="item_13660c30-272">asked whether the mortgage payment includes taxes and insurance</ref> but moved on after receiving <ref job="SRJ_gRhx42GaQjwb" item="item_b5147912-c62">only a payment amount</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Track required question components separately; before advancing, ask a short follow-up for an unanswered component, including explicit comfort with a variable HELOC rate.
issues.label: Incomplete discovery

issues.description: When borrowers <ref job="SRJ_rQaQ7dAu4Z8a" item="item_b5427ec8-994">declined to name their employer</ref> or <ref job="SRJ_kSywi63tJVFA" item="item_110f72d3-eea">provided tenure and salaried status only</ref>, the agent went straight to the <ref job="SRJ_kSywi63tJVFA" item="item_6bbd1478-373">closing choice</ref> without addressing the missing field. This occurred across the refinance and home-equity tracks.
issues.suggestion: Acknowledge a refusal without pressuring the borrower, mark the employer name as declined or unknown, and ask only if a missing field is genuinely required before the next step.
